body:
📦 **ArtGallery `cdb2234`** — art: exhibit cured bonito goods and tavern plate icons

Preserve two image_gen white masters, exact prompts and128px/32px light/dark board against existing salt-fish. Thick pale fish steaks with silver-blue skin distinguish lakerda from a whole split dried fish. Plate adds bread, red onion and a compact wooden tabletop. Gallery-first before game import. Build and --check pass.

Subject references: Istanbul Chamber of Commerce Bosphorus lakerda description and Kocaman salted-bonito product. These identify cured bonito, not the historical recipe or gameplay. Style references: Sirius salt-fish, fish-supper and TASK-0896 tools masters, actually attached.

Refs TASK-1035

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
